notes.title: August 4th Release Date!
notes.notes: Mibibli's Quest is coming out August 4th for PC and Mac! The game can be purchased for $6.49 (CDN, $5.99 USD) while the 51 track soundtrack will also be released on the 4th for $4.49 (CDN, $3.99 USD)
